name: Find Project Entry Points When Target File Not Found
description: When asked to read a specific file that doesn't exist, explore the project structure to identify the actual entry points by examining package.json and searching for main files
steps: Attempt to read the specific file requested by user
If file not found, search for files broadly in the project
Search for alternative versions of the file (e.g., index.ts)
Read package.json to understand project metadata and entry points
Check for tsconfig.json to understand project structure
Identify actual entry points from package.json exports/bin fields
Report findings with correct file paths to user
